question: Which deities and lord are named in this group of mothers?
premises: Vārāhī, Māhendrī, and Cāmuṇḍī are named
inference: The verse lists members of the maternal retinue.
uncertainties: whether Gaṇādhipa is separate from the mothers
plain_english: Vārāhī, Māhendrī, Cāmuṇḍī, and the lord of the gaṇas.
